name: Tsuwano Castle
description: Tsuwano Castle crowns the hill above the picture-postcard Tsuwano castle town. The stone-walled ruins are reached by ropeway (also a scenic highlight), offering views over the town of the Mori-influenced Kamei domain.
notes: Ropeway round trip ¥720 (castle ruins free); the castle town below is the main attraction.
